coverage.name: Audited Singapore public bus frequency estimates
coverage.holidayReview: No public holidays occur in this source-validity window. Holidays require a separately reviewed operator day mapping; no automatic Sunday fallback.

assumptions.unverifiedBayReason: Every retained source service origin and destination, including excluded service patterns, may use different alighting and boarding bays. Where such a code is included as a stop, same-stop bus transfers are disabled without a reviewed internal path; journey starts and ends remain allowed.
assumptions.waitBasis: Use the upper bound of the published dispatch interval as an estimated wait at boarding stops. Headways can vary downstream; this is not a guaranteed wait or an exact departure.
assumptions.rideBasis: Distance differences from DataMall at an assumed 18 km/h, plus 30 seconds for each downstream stop. An explicit uncalibrated planning model, not measured or scheduled running times.
assumptions.headwayDayScope: The guide publishes generic dispatch bands, without separate weekday/weekend frequency arrays. WD/SAT/SUN first/last spans gate each operating day. Applying published bands on those days is an explicit uncalibrated estimate, never a timetable or guaranteed maximum wait.
assumptions.firstLastBasis: First/last clock spans are service-day constraints; last before first rolls into the following civil day. Previous service day is checked after midnight. A first arrival is a known bound, never expanded into exact intermediate departures.
assumptions.earlyHoursBasis: Before 06:30 on a new service day the guide provides no headway band. Only an explicitly published first arrival can be considered; no continuous early-morning frequency is inferred.
assumptions.limitedSpanPolicy: A service day with an origin first/last span shorter than six hours is withheld pending service-specific trip-rule review. This conservative threshold does not assert that every short span is a fixed-trip service. Generic AM-offpeak metadata alone cannot prove continuous operation; other independently available days remain eligible.
